about: DogRecs starter catalog (2026-11-14): dog beds, crates and carriers, harnesses/collars/leashes, toys and non-edible chews, GPS trackers and pet cameras, grooming tools, bowls/feeders/fountains and dog food; owner build list 2026-11-12, builder plan pre-approved 2026-11-14. One product per maker model or line: sizes and colours merge, each generation is its own product (Fi Series 3 vs Series 3+, Halo Collar 3/4/5, Furbo 360° vs Furbo Mini vs Mini 360°, Tractive DOG 4 vs DOG 6), and each dog food formula is its own product (bag sizes merge). No prescription or veterinary diets, medications, supplements, treats, shampoos or e-collars. Names and specs are read on the makers' own pages; where a maker site refused automated fetches (many Shopify stores, purina.com, yeti.com), on search excerpts of the maker page or a major retailer listing showing the maker's name. Specs: shape = category, surface = type, balance = sizes or life stage, core = main material or first ingredient, weight = one headline maker figure. No health claims in any field. Blank = not confirmed. Years only where a dated page shows the launch.
